notes:
Inbound SMB lead. Primary product interest: hosted API for chat and summarization inside their collaborative design app. Self-serve signup, low-touch so far. Key pain: latency for European end users — they see many aborted chats due to client timeouts. Customer quoted: "EU users get long waits, our web client times out at 3s and shows 'server unreachable'". They currently route all requests to us-central by default; many users are in EU/UK.

Technical details observed from traces (SE): avg response times by region from their tests: us-central ~180-320ms, us-west ~220-400ms, eu-west ~700-1200ms (non-streaming full-response), p95 spikes on long prompts (>2.5k tokens). Payload notes: typical prompt includes 3 documents (~800-1200 tokens) + user message; they do full-response mode (no streaming) in client.

Customer asks for: region recommendation, timeout settings, prompt-length guidance, token-cost estimate for summaries. Suggested quick wins:
- Move EU traffic to eu-west region (deploy hosted model with region routing)
- Adopt streaming responses in the web client to show progressive output and avoid 3s hard timeouts
- Increase client-side timeout to 10s for initial POC while improving prompt length via document chunking
- Use prefix/KV caching for repeated system instructions and static context
- Recommend max prompt window for responsive UI: keep prompts <1.5k tokens for p50-like UX; chunk >1.5k into retrieval steps
- Provide sample timeouts: socket/read timeout 12s, connect 2s, per-request server timeout 25s (backend safeguard)

Trials so far: they prefer default open models (gpt-like open checkpoints). Cost sensitivity: medium — wants predictable per-user price. Mentioned competitors they evaluated: OpenAI (faster region availability), Anthropic.

Next 1:1 activities: schedule 30-min perf tuning call (Jordan + Maya + PetalBridge eng lead) to walk through region routing and show quick config changes. Deliverables: short Region & Timeouts quickstart doc, sample streaming client snippet, token-cost estimate for their average session.

CRM style notes: short, choppy entries ok. Customer open to small paid pilot if first week of POC shows p95 < 1s for EU chats.
